units.source_text: 此时源氏公子的宫邸内，正在为追荐桐壶院而举办法华八讲，规模之盛大，轰动一时。

en.t: At this time, in Prince Genji's mansion, the eight lectures on the Lotus Sutra were being held in memory of the Kiritsubo Emperor, and their magnificent scale became the talk of the day.

units.source_text: 选聘法师时，普通的僧人都不要，专选学识丰富、道行高深的圣僧。

en.t: When selecting the officiating monks, ordinary priests were not accepted; only holy monks of deep learning and lofty practice were chosen.

units.source_text: 末摘花的哥哥禅师也参与其间。

en.t: The monk who was Suetsumuhana's elder brother also took part in the ceremonies.

units.source_text: 功德圆满之后，禅师将回山时，乘便到常陆宫邸来访问妹妹，对她言道：“

en.t: After the rites had been completed, the monk was about to return to his mountain temple, and on the way he stopped at the Hitachi Palace residence to visit his sister and said to her, "

units.source_text: 为追荐桐壶院，我来参与源氏权大纳言的法华八讲。

en.t: I came to take part in the Provisional Major Counselor Genji's eight lectures on the Lotus Sutra, held in memory of the Kiritsubo Emperor.
What a splendid Buddhist service it was!

units.source_text: 那庄严妙相，几疑此乃现世的极乐净土。

en.t: Its solemn and wondrous beauty almost made one wonder whether this was the Pure Land of Bliss appearing in the present world.

units.source_text: 音乐舞蹈等等，无不尽善尽美。

en.t: The music, the dances, and everything else were perfect in every way.

units.source_text: 源氏公子正是佛菩萨化身！

en.t: Prince Genji is truly an incarnation of a buddha or bodhisattva!

units.source_text: 在这五浊根深的娑婆世界中，怎么会生出如此端庄美妙的人物来呢？”

en.t: How could such a graceful and beautiful person be born into this saha world, so deeply rooted in the five defilements?"
After speaking only briefly, he immediately took his leave.

units.source_text: 原来这两人不像世间普通兄妹，他们相见时无话可说，连拉拉杂杂的闲话也不谈。

en.t: In fact, these two were unlike ordinary siblings in the world: when they met, they had nothing to say to each other, and did not even exchange idle chatter.
